game_title: Examination practice · Branch Assembly 4 · Separate Outputs
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza, a giant sundial plaza: the desert nomad must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza: a giant sundial plaza
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 5 examination practice: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 22. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (3, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 5. IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Deliver exactly 14 components (7 upper, 7 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 14.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Edge Case Hunter' (Week 9 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sundial Plaza'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Collect 550 points of sun cloaks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Edge Case Hunter – Sundial Plaza Rush
hint: IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Branch contracts: IF: 7 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_upper; ELSE: 7 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_lower. Power the junctions and production machines. A blocked branch waits without losing items.
